summary: Backend-only validation completed for deterministic Internal Data AI month comparisons. Targeted unit and authenticated live tests for two-month and three-month Scope 1 emission queries passed on public URL.
action_items: No blocking fix required for requested backend scope.
Optional maintainability: split /app/backend/modules/internal_data_ai/response_builder.py (>700 lines) into focused formatter modules.
critical_code_review_comments: response_builder.py is 900+ lines, which increases regression risk and should be decomposed into smaller modules.
The comparison renderer trusts stored emissions_unit when present; keep upstream normalization strict to tCO2e to preserve unit-standard contract.
test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md and used admin credentials for live auth.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ran PYTHONPATH=/app/backend pytest on period-comparison unit tests + new live iter180 contract tests (13/13 pass). Live checks validated /api/internal-ai/chat query_type=emission_lookup for both 'July vs June 2026' and 'July vs June vs May 2026', exact month labels, tCO2e total row, required variance columns, optional chart with 3 points when present, and no internal ID/formula leakage.
rca of the issue: No failure reproduced in requested scope. Deterministic behavior validated end-to-end: month extraction supports any count of explicit months with year inheritance, executor runs strict per-period queries, and response formatter renders first-period reference variances across later months.
